summary: Today we conducted the session of the Study Habits session for 10th standard students of Dr N D Patil School, Charkop, Kandivli West.
description:
Today we conducted the session of the Study Habits session for 10th standard students of Dr N D Patil School, Charkop, Kandivli West. The session was conducted by PP Rtn Sunita Hirlekar

We are thankful to Sunita ji for conducting the session which will make a huge difference in grades of these students at such an important milestone. We also thank PE Rtn Dharmendra Goel, Rtn Vikas Hirlekar, Rtn Nirmalaji Rajput, Rtn Ashish Agarwal, R/ann Jasmita Bhatt for motivating the children with their presence.
